prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” broker for everyone, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage: it says it compares Marketplace and private plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves both sides of the Kansas–Missouri line. Its site lists a North Kansas City office and phone number: **816-205-7066**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

You could also compare with **Apollo Health Insurance** in Lee’s Summit (**816-400-4477**) or **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** in Overland Park (**913-333-8627**); both advertise help with individual and family plans. [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/) · [AIS](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker is licensed in your state, which insurers they can compare, whether they’ll check your doctors and prescriptions, and whether their help costs you anything. Your home address matters because Marketplace plans depend on whether you live in Missouri or Kansas.
